title: SOVCTX Operator Vocabulary & Semantic Evolution Index

transition_phases.focus: Abstract functional analysis and normed rings (Gelfand). Operators as elements of algebraic structures.
transition_phases.context: Classical differential and integral operators in functional spaces.

transition_phases.focus: Transformation operators (операторы преобразования, Povzner–Levitan–Marchenko).
transition_phases.context: Integral kernels mapping unperturbed differential operators to perturbed physical systems.

transition_phases.focus: Ill-posed operator equations and regularizing operators (Tikhonov). Resolvent operators in scattering (Faddeev).
transition_phases.context: Operators that invert noisy data into physical parameters subject to compactness and stability.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Primary mathematical agent of system transformation (T: X -> Y).

transition_phases.focus: Kinematic mechanism transformations (Chebyshev).
transition_phases.context: Geometric transformations of mechanical linkages preserving rectilinear or circular paths.

transition_phases.focus: Canonical transformations in phase space and Hamiltonian control (Pontryagin).
transition_phases.context: Coordinate transforms that preserve symplectic structure and Hamiltonian equations.

transition_phases.focus: Volterra transformation operator in inverse spectral theory (Gelfand–Levitan).
transition_phases.context: Mapping solutions of y'' + q(x)y = lambda y into cos(sqrt(lambda) x) via triangular kernel.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Action mapping one coordinate, state, or operator representation into another.

transition_phases.focus: Chebyshev interval mapping and Lavrentyev continuous/quasiconformal mappings.
transition_phases.context: Minimizing maximum distortion under continuous geometric mappings.

transition_phases.focus: Forward and inverse mappings between state and data spaces (Tikhonov).
transition_phases.context: Mapping compact sets in metric spaces to establish conditional continuous invertibility.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Preservation of geometric, topological, or analytical properties under domain deformation.

transition_phases.focus: Tikhonov smoothing functional: M^alpha[z] = ||Az - u||^2 + alpha * Omega[z].
transition_phases.context: Balancing fidelity to noisy observation with a stabilizing penalty on solution roughness.

transition_phases.focus: Pontryagin cost functional: J = integral f^0(x, u) dt.
transition_phases.context: Integral objective minimized over non-smooth admissible control paths.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Scalar-valued mapping on infinite-dimensional state spaces governing selection and optimization.

transition_phases.focus: Lyapunov perturbed and unperturbed state trajectories.
transition_phases.context: Deviation variables x_k(t) describing displacement from a reference motion.

transition_phases.focus: Collective state in phase space: distribution function f(r, v, t) (Vlasov, Bogolyubov).
transition_phases.context: Abandoning individual particle states in favor of continuous probability density in 6D phase space.

transition_phases.focus: Pontryagin phase state x(t) and conjugate momentum psi(t).
transition_phases.context: Evolution of internal state under external admissible control inputs.

transition_phases.focus: Pontryagin optimal trajectory connecting initial state x_0 to target set X_1.
transition_phases.context: Curves driven by piecewise continuous controls with trajectory corners.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Parameterized curve x(t) traced by a dynamical system in phase space.

transition_phases.focus: Lyapunov stability: boundedness of trajectories under initial perturbations.
transition_phases.context: Construction of scalar Lyapunov functions V(x) without explicit solution integration.

transition_phases.focus: Andronov–Pontryagin structural stability (грубость).
transition_phases.context: Preservation of topological phase portrait under small perturbations of the vector field itself.

transition_phases.focus: Tikhonov stability of inverse operators under observation noise.
transition_phases.context: Continuous dependence of reconstructed state on measurement errors in metric topologies.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Invariance of qualitative behavior under state perturbations or model/data uncertainties.

transition_phases.focus: First integrals of motion (Lyapunov) and Liouville phase-volume invariance (Vlasov).
transition_phases.context: Conservation of Hamiltonian energy, momentum, and 6D phase space volume df/dt = 0.

transition_phases.focus: Topological invariants of dynamical systems and gauge invariants in field theory (Faddeev).
transition_phases.context: Betti numbers of phase portraits and gauge-fixing invariants via Faddeev–Popov ghosts.

vocabulary_terms.operator_role: Quantity, subspace, or topological property preserved under system evolution.

transition_phases.context: Restricting inverse search to compact or bounded subsets where uniqueness and continuity hold.

transition_phases.focus: Gelfand–Levitan admissible spectral functions.
transition_phases.context: Monotonicity and asymptotic behavior required for a function to generate a physical potential.
